actions.text: Received in the Senate and Read twice and referred to the Committee on Environment and Public Works.
Motion to reconsider laid on the table Agreed to without objection.
On motion to suspend the rules and pass the bill Agreed to by the Yeas and Nays: (2/3 required): 397 - 1 (Roll no. 240). (text: CR H3876)
Passed/agreed to in House: On motion to suspend the rules and pass the bill Agreed to by the Yeas and Nays: (2/3 required): 397 - 1 (Roll no. 240). (text: CR H3876: 1)
Considered as unfinished business. (consideration: CR H3880-3881)

At the conclusion of debate, the Yeas and Nays were demanded and ordered. Pursuant to the provisions of clause 8, rule XX, the Chair announced that further proceedings on the motion would be postponed.
DEBATE - The House proceeded with forty minutes of debate on H.R. 3424.
Considered under suspension of the rules. (consideration: CR H3876-3877)
Mr. Barrett moved to suspend the rules and pass the bill.
Placed on the Union Calendar, Calendar No. 195.
Reported by the Committee on Transportation and Infrastructure. H. Rept. 119-238.

dimensions.assessment: Directly involves the GSA and federal agencies occupying leased space.
dimensions.evidence: collaborate with tenants of federally-leased space to better identify concerns among Federal agencies around shared-space arrangements

dimensions.assessment: Involves administrative coordination, criteria development, and congressional briefings rather than major operational overhauls.
dimensions.evidence: establish measurable objectives, in consultation with the tenants of federally-leased space, to quantify the success

dimensions.assessment: No appropriations or federal spending amounts are specified in the text.
Directs specific administrative actions related to existing property management statutes.
dimensions.evidence: In carrying out section 2302 of the Thomas R. Carper Water Resources Development Act of 2024

dimensions.assessment: Includes ongoing administrative duties alongside a one-time briefing requirement within six months.
dimensions.evidence: Not later than 6 months after the date of enactment of this Act, the Administrator shall brief the Committee

missing_information: Cost estimates or budgetary impact of implementing shared-space criteria
importance_detail.rationale: The bill directs the GSA to collaborate with federal tenants on shared-space arrangements in federally leased buildings and brief Congress, creating administrative and reporting requirements.
